name: Bolajon
tagline: The place your child asks to go back to
niche: Children’s development centre and mini kindergarten

listing.description: A website for a kids’ centre, private kindergarten or after-school clubs. Bright shapes with bold outlines, stickers you can drag around the first screen, clubs as colourful cards and a trail of steps.

seo.title: Bolajon — children’s development centre in Tashkent
seo.description: Mini kindergarten from age 2, school readiness, English, robotics and art. Groups of up to 8 children, free trial lesson.
seo.answer: Bolajon is a children’s development centre in Yunusabad, Tashkent: a mini kindergarten for ages 2–6 from 8:00 to 19:00, school readiness, English, robotics and art. Groups have no more than 8 children, a club pass starts at 480,000 UZS per month, the mini kindergarten is 2,900,000 UZS per month, and the trial lesson is free.

sections.title: We play for real
sections.subtitle: A mini kindergarten, school readiness and clubs in Yunusabad. Small groups, bright rooms and teachers who remember what every child loves.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Learning through play, not instead of it
sections.text: Bolajon opened in 2019, when we were looking for a place for our own children and couldn’t find one. There are no rows of desks and no grades: children build, draw, count pine cones and speak English over lunch. Groups have no more than eight children, so the teacher notices everyone. Parents get a short report with photos on Telegram every day.

sections.label: Clubs
sections.title: What happens here
sections.intro: A monthly pass covers 8 lessons. The first lesson in any club is free.

items.title: Mini kindergarten
items.text: A full day from 8:00 to 19:00: breakfast, lunch, nap, outdoor time and lessons.

items.title: School readiness
items.text: Reading by syllables, counting to 100, writing and sitting still for 30 minutes.

items.title: English
items.text: Songs, games and short conversations with a native speaker once a week.

items.title: Robotics
items.text: LEGO Education kits and first programs on a tablet.

items.title: Art
items.text: Gouache, clay and collage. Take the work home — or frame it for our exhibition.

items.title: Speech therapy
items.text: One-to-one 30-minute sessions after a free assessment.

items.title: Request
items.text: Message us on Telegram or call — we pick a club for your child’s age.

items.title: Meet us
items.text: Come together: your child plays while you look around.

items.title: Trial lesson
items.text: Free and with no commitment. A parent can stay close by.

items.title: Monthly pass
items.text: If you like it, we set up the pass, the contract and the group chat.

items.name: One club
features: Lessons missed through illness are carried over

items.quote: My son used to cry at every door, but here he drags me by the hand. Six months on, he reads shop signs on his own.
items.author: Nilufar, Amir’s mum

items.quote: Daily photo updates mean I’m calm at work. And now my daughter builds robots at home too.
items.author: Dmitry, Sonya’s dad

items.q: From what age do you accept children?
items.a: The mini kindergarten from age 2, if the child is toilet-trained. Clubs from 3, robotics from 6.
We cook ourselves, four times a day: porridge, soups, vegetables, meat and fruit. The weekly menu is in the group chat and allergies are taken into account.

items.q: Can we come for just one month?
items.a: Yes, passes are monthly with no joining fee. Just give two weeks’ notice before leaving.

items.q: What if my child is ill?
items.a: Lessons missed through illness are moved to another day. In the kindergarten we adjust the fee for a missed week with a doctor’s note.

items.q: How will I know how the day went?
items.a: Every evening the teacher sends a short Telegram report: what they did, how your child ate and slept, plus a couple of photos.

sections.label: Trial
sections.title: Come and play
sections.text: Send your child’s name and age — we’ll suggest a club and a time for the trial lesson.
